description_expanded: Overview5.0(1 review)LAKESIDE VILLA Private Dock • Kayaks • Coastal Dune Lake • Minutes to 30A Beaches Wake up to the still water of Camp Creek Lake, where your morning might begin with coffee on the dock and end with a sunset paddle across the water. Lakeside Villa offers something surprisingly rare along 30A, true lakefront living with direct water access, while still being just minutes from the Gulf. Instead of fighting for beach parking or crowded boardwalks, your day can start right outside the back door. Launch a kayak from the private dock, pedal across the lake, or bike the scenic paths along 30A before returning to the quiet rhythm of the water. It’s the kind of place where days naturally unfold outdoors and evenings slow down around the fire. THE LAKE EXPERIENCE Camp Creek Lake is one of only a handful of coastal dune lakes found anywhere in the world. These unique lakes sit just behind the Gulf and occasionally open to the ocean, creating calm waters perfect for paddling, fishing, and wildlife watching. From the private dock, guests can: Paddle across the lake to a quiet beach access Fish directly from the dock Watch herons, osprey, and turtles in the early morning light Take sunset kayak rides across glass-smooth water If you prefer the ocean, a private beach is only a 300-yard paddle, while public beach access is a 10-minute walk or short bike ride away. Few places along 30A offer this balance of lake tranquility and beach access. OUTDOOR LIVING The lake becomes part of the experience of staying here. Guests enjoy: Private dock on Camp Creek Lake 2 kayaks and a paddleboard for exploring the water 4 bikes for riding along scenic 30A Lakeside deck for coffee, meals, and sunset drinks Beach chairs, umbrellas, and toys ready for your beach days Outdoor shower after a day at the beach Whether you spend the afternoon paddling or simply relaxing by the water, the lake creates a peaceful backdrop to the entire stay. INSIDE THE HOME Lakeside Villa is designed to feel easy, comfortable, and welcoming after long days outdoors. Large windows and the balcony overlook the lake, filling the space with natural light and keeping the water always in view. The home includes two bedrooms and one bathroom and comfortably sleeps up to 5 guests, making it ideal for: small families couples traveling together friends looking for a relaxed 30A getaway After a beach day or lake adventure, it’s a perfect place to cook a meal, unwind, and watch the sun settle over the water. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS Primary Bedroom: Queen Bed Second Bedroom: Two Twin Beds Living Area: Twin Sleeper Sofa Ideal for families with children or small groups. EXPLORE NEARBY 30A One of the best parts of this location is how easy it is to enjoy the nearby towns while still returning to the quiet of the lake. Just minutes away: The Big Chill (formerly The Hub) — 3 minutes Outdoor restaurants, music, movies on the big screen, and a lively gathering space. You can spend the day exploring 30A’s shops, restaurants, and beaches, then come back to the calm water of Camp Creek Lake. WHY GUESTS LOVE STAYING HERE Guests often say the lake becomes their favorite part of the trip. Mornings are quiet and peaceful. Afternoons bring paddling, fishing, or beach rides on bikes. Evenings slow down around the fire pit while the sun sets over the water. It’s a rare place along 30A where you get both the energy of the beach towns and the quiet of the lake. Your 30A Lake Retreat Coffee on the dock. Kayaks in the water. Sunsets across the lake. Welcome to Lakeside Villa. Lakeside Villa: Lower floor of a two-level cottage.Show less
